title: Brakes.
officialText:
Every power buggy shall be provided with brakes and tire surfaces capable of bringing it to a full stop
within 25 feet (635 mm) on a level surface that is similar to the one on which it will be used and at full rated load and
maximum design speed. Brakes shall be capable of being fixed in engagement to hold the full load stationary on a 25 percent
grade.
